generation.parameters: one user message [text, image_url(data:image/png;base64)] per examples/common.py; reasoning_effort medium; max_completion_tokens 8192; no temperature/top_p/seed; image detail unset
generation.battery: 102 DSReal items x 3 seeds = 306 archived calls in baseline_alive/calls.jsonl

scorer.per_response_rule: all fenced blocks (extract_python_code_from_text); success if ANY executes and matches (src/turtleai/eval/eval_responses.py, paper App. F.3) - NOT examples/eval_model_dataset.py's codes[0]
scorer.isolation: fresh interpreter per response (subprocess -I, cwd=temp dir, OPENAI_API_KEY stripped), timeout 120.0s
scorer.ghostscript_shim: Ghostscript absent: emulator.convert_img_to_base64 (EPS -> PNG raster) replaced by a placeholder. The symbolic metric compares recorded turtle states, never that raster, so the score is unaffected; every other emulator check still runs.

results.judged_by: automatic rule per ANALYSIS_PLAN Sec. 1 as instantiated in the card: survived if the median-of-seeds rate falls inside the item bootstrap band around 40.20% and stays below 60%; partial if outside the band but still failing the majority; dead above 60% or on a non-truncation collapse. results.note: 34.31% [95% CI 27.45, 43.14] vs the reported 40.20% (band [31.37, 49.02]); per seed [34.31, 37.25, 34.31]; 30 no-code replies, 13 truncated.

reproducibility_frictions_observed: Table 1 reports only aggregate percentages; no per-item outputs are released, so the comparison is percentage-to-percentage (n=102, item bootstrap band around 40.20% is [31.37, 49.02])

examples/eval_model_dataset.py scores only the first extracted code block; the paper's rule (App. F.3, src/turtleai/eval/eval_responses.py) executes every block and counts the task correct if any matches - the latter is used here
examples/common.py passes no decoding parameters at all; reasoning_effort=medium and max_completion_tokens=8192 come from App. F.3

the scorer executes model-generated turtle code: run here in a fresh isolated interpreter per response with a 120s wall clock (the repo uses a pebble ProcessPool with a 60s timeout; pebble is not installed here)

Ghostscript absent: emulator.convert_img_to_base64 (EPS -> PNG raster) replaced by a placeholder. The symbolic metric compares recorded turtle states, never that raster, so the score is unaffected; every other emulator check still runs.
13 of 306 replies hit finish_reason='length' (13 of them with no code block): reasoning-token truncation, reported separately before being folded into the failure count
